recipes.title: Chocolate chip cookies
recipes.blurb: Crisp edges, soft centers, melty chips

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture just until combined, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake one sheet at a time until the edges are golden but centers look soft.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Oatmeal raisin cookies
recipes.blurb: Chewy, cinnamon-spiced and loaded with raisins

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt together.
Beat the butter with both sugars until fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture, then the oats and raisins.
Scoop heaping tablespoons onto the sheets, 2 inches apart, and flatten slightly.
Bake until golden at the edges and just set in the middle.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Peanut butter cookies
recipes.blurb: Classic fork-marked cookies, soft and nutty

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter, peanut butter and both sugars until creamy, then beat in the egg.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt until a soft dough forms.
Roll into 1-inch balls and set them 2 inches apart on the sheets.
Press each ball with a fork in a crisscross pattern.
Bake until the edges are lightly golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes; they firm up as they cool.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
recipes.blurb: Soft, tangy cinnamon-sugar cookies

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt together.
Beat the butter and 1.5 cups sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture to make a soft dough.
Mix the rolling sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Roll the dough into 1.5-inch balls, coat in cinnamon sugar and place 2 inches apart.
Bake until the edges are set; centers will look slightly underdone.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Classic shortbread wedges
recipes.blurb: Buttery, crumbly three-ingredient style cookies

steps.text: Heat the oven to 325°F. Have a 9-inch round or square pan ready.
Beat the butter, powdered sugar, salt and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Mix in the flour on low until a crumbly dough forms.
Press the dough evenly into the pan and prick all over with a fork.
Bake until pale golden at the edges.
While still warm, cut into 16 wedges or bars, then let cool completely in the pan.

recipes.title: Molasses crinkle cookies
recipes.blurb: Chewy ginger-spice cookies with sugar crackle

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and salt together.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Stir in the flour mixture. Chill the dough until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Roll the dough into 1.5-inch balls and coat generously in sugar.
Bake until the tops crack and the edges are set.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Double chocolate cookies
recipes.blurb: Fudgy cocoa cookies packed with chocolate chips

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt together.
Beat the butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop heaping tablespoons onto the sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake until the edges are set; the centers will look soft.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Lemon crinkle cookies
recipes.blurb: Soft, bright lemon cookies rolled in powdered sugar

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Beat the butter, sugar and lemon zest until fluffy. Beat in the eggs, lemon juice and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture. Cover and chill until firm enough to roll.
Heat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls and coat very thickly in powdered sugar.
Place 2 inches apart and bake until the edges are just set.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Chewy sugar cookies
recipes.blurb: Soft bakery-style cookies with sparkly sugar tops

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt together.
Whisk the melted butter and 1 cup sugar, then whisk in the egg, milk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture until a soft dough forms.
Roll into 1.5-inch balls, coat in the rolling sugar and place 2 inches apart.
Bake until the edges are set and the tops look a little puffy.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet; they will settle and stay chewy.

recipes.title: Fudgy cocoa brownies
recipes.blurb: Dense, chewy brownies from pantry staples

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line an 8-inch square pan with parchment, leaving an overhang.
Stir the melted butter and sugar together in a bowl.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder until just combined.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely in the pan, then lift out and cut into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Cream cheese swirl brownies
recipes.blurb: Fudgy brownies with a tangy cheesecake ribbon

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Whisk the butter and 2 cups sugar, then beat in 4 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder. Spread two-thirds of the batter in the pan.
Beat the cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar, the last egg and vanilla until smooth.
Spread the cream cheese over the batter, dollop the remaining batter on top and swirl with a knife.
Bake until the edges pull away and the center is just set.
Cool completely, then chill 1 hour before cutting into 24 bars. Keep refrigerated.

recipes.title: Chocolate chip blondies
recipes.blurb: Butterscotchy brown sugar bars with chips

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Whisk the melted butter and brown sugar until smooth.
Whisk in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt, then fold in the chocolate chips.
Spread the thick batter evenly in the pan.
Bake until golden and a toothpick has a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely in the pan, then cut into 24 bars.

recipes.title: Lemon bars
recipes.blurb: Shortbread crust with a silky, tart lemon filling

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Pulse or mix 1 3/4 cups flour, 1/2 cup powdered sugar and the butter until crumbly. Press into the pan.
Bake the crust until lightly golden.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, remaining 1/4 cup flour, lemon juice and zest until smooth.
Pour the filling over the hot crust.
Bake until the filling is set and no longer jiggles in the center.
Cool completely, chill 1 hour, then dust with powdered sugar and cut into 24 bars.

recipes.title: Seven layer magic bars
recipes.blurb: Graham, chocolate, coconut, pecans and condensed milk

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Mix the graham crumbs and melted butter, then press firmly into the pan.
Sprinkle the chocolate chips, then butterscotch chips, coconut and pecans over the crust.
Pour the condensed milk evenly over the top.
Bake until the coconut is golden and the edges bubble.
Cool completely in the pan before cutting into 24 bars.

recipes.title: Raspberry oatmeal bars
recipes.blurb: Buttery oat crumble layered with jam

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Stir the flour, oats, brown sugar, baking soda and salt together.
Stir in the melted butter until the mixture is crumbly and clumps.
Press about three-quarters of the crumbs firmly into the pan.
Spread the jam over the crust, then scatter the rest of the crumbs on top.
Bake until the top is golden and the jam bubbles at the edges.
Cool completely before cutting into 24 bars.

recipes.title: Pumpkin bars with cream cheese frosting
recipes.blurb: Moist spiced pumpkin sheet bars for a crowd

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 10x15-inch rimmed pan.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar and pumpkin until smooth.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon until just combined.
Spread the batter in the pan.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely in the pan.
Beat the cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread over the bars and cut into 24.

recipes.title: Graham cracker cheesecake bars
recipes.blurb: Creamy cheesecake squares on a buttery crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Mix the graham crumbs, butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Press firmly into the pan.
Bake the crust until set.
Beat the cream cheese and 3/4 cup sugar until smooth. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Pour the filling over the warm crust.
Bake until the edges are set and the center barely jiggles.
Cool 1 hour, then chill at least 4 hours before cutting into 18 bars.

recipes.title: Peanut butter swirl brownies
recipes.blurb: Chewy chocolate brownies with ribbons of peanut butter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line an 8-inch square pan with parchment, leaving an overhang.
Stir the melted butter and sugar, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder until just combined. Spread in the pan.
Warm the peanut butter and powdered sugar in the microwave for 15 seconds and stir until smooth.
Drop spoonfuls of peanut butter over the batter and swirl with a knife.
Bake until a toothpick has a few moist crumbs; the edges will be set.
Cool completely in the pan, then lift out and cut into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream
recipes.blurb: Tender birthday-party cupcakes, swirled with frosting

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Beat 1/2 cup butter and the sugar until fluffy. Beat in the eggs and 2 tsp vanilla.
Add the flour mixture in thirds, alternating with the 3/4 cup milk, mixing just until smooth.
Fill the liners two-thirds full.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean and the tops spring back.
Cool completely. Beat 1 cup butter until creamy, then beat in the powdered sugar, 2 tbsp milk and 1 tsp vanilla for 3 minutes.
Frost the cooled cupcakes.

recipes.title: Chocolate sheet cake
recipes.blurb: Thin, fudgy cake with warm cocoa icing

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease an 18x13-inch rimmed baking sheet.
Whisk the flour, sugar, salt and baking soda in a large bowl.
Boil 1 cup butter, the water and 1/4 cup cocoa in a saucepan, then pour over the dry mix and stir.
Whisk in the buttermilk, eggs and vanilla. Pour the thin batter into the pan.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Five minutes before it is done, boil 1/2 cup butter, 1/4 cup cocoa and the milk, then whisk in the powdered sugar.
Pour the warm icing over the warm cake, spread and cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Carrot cake with cream cheese frosting
recipes.blurb: Spiced two-layer cake with walnuts

ingredients.note: peeled and finely grated, about 3 cups

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and line two 9-inch round pans with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon together.
Whisk the sugar, oil and eggs until smooth.
Stir in the flour mixture, then the carrots and walnuts. Divide between the pans.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes, turn out and cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese and butter smooth, then beat in the powdered sugar and vanilla.
Frost between the layers and over the top.

recipes.title: Sour cream pound cake
recipes.blurb: Dense, moist, golden bundt cake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 325°F. Grease and flour a 10-cup bundt pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt together.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, about 4 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Add the flour mixture in thirds, alternating with the sour cream, mixing just until smooth.
Scrape the batter into the pan and smooth the top.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes, turn out onto a rack, cool and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Lemon blueberry loaf cake
recipes.blurb: Bright, tender loaf with a lemon glaze

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and line a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Toss the blueberries with 1 tablespoon of the flour. Whisk the rest of the flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat the butter, sugar and lemon zest until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Stir in the flour mixture, milk and 2 tbsp lemon juice just until combined. Fold in the berries.
Spread in the pan and bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes, then lift out onto a rack to cool completely.
Whisk the powdered sugar and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Drizzle over the loaf.

recipes.title: Banana snack cake
recipes.blurb: Moist one-pan cake for overripe bananas

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt and cinnamon together.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs.
Mix in the mashed bananas, sour cream and vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture just until combined and spread in the pan.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan, dust with powdered sugar and cut into 15 squares.

recipes.title: Wacky chocolate cake
recipes.blurb: Egg-free, dairy-free, one-pan chocolate cake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Have a 9x13-inch pan ready (no need to grease).
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda and salt in the pan.
Make three wells in the dry mix. Pour the vinegar, vanilla and oil into the wells.
Pour the cold water over everything.
Stir with a fork until smooth, scraping the corners.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the pan and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Pineapple upside-down cake
recipes.blurb: Caramelized pineapple rings on a buttery cake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Pour the melted butter into a 9-inch round cake pan or cast iron skillet.
Sprinkle the brown sugar over the butter and arrange the pineapple rings on top.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Beat the softened butter and sugar until fluffy, then the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour in thirds, alternating with the milk. Spread over the pineapple.
Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes, run a knife around the edge and flip onto a plate.

recipes.title: Classic double-crust apple pie
recipes.blurb: Flaky all-butter crust and cinnamon apples

ingredients.note: Granny Smith or Honeycrisp, peeled and sliced

steps.text: Mix 2.5 cups flour, salt and 1 tbsp sugar. Cut in the cold butter until pea-sized pieces remain.
Sprinkle in the ice water, 1 tbsp at a time, until the dough just holds together.
Divide into two discs, wrap and chill until firm.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the apples with 3/4 cup sugar, 2 tbsp flour, cinnamon and lemon juice.
Roll one disc to fit a 9-inch pie plate. Fill with apples and dot with butter.
Roll the second disc, cover the pie, crimp the edges and cut 4 steam vents. Brush with egg.
Bake at 425°F, then lower to 375°F.
Bake at 375°F until golden and the juices bubble.
Cool at least 3 hours so the filling sets.

recipes.title: Apple crisp
recipes.blurb: Warm cinnamon apples under a buttery oat topping

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch square baking dish.
Toss the apples with the sugar, lemon juice, 1 tbsp flour and 1 tsp cinnamon. Spread in the dish.
Mix the oats, 3/4 cup flour, brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and salt.
Rub in the cold butter until the topping is crumbly and clumpy.
Scatter the topping over the apples.
Bake until the topping is golden and the apples are tender and bubbling.
Cool 15 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.title: Southern peach cobbler
recipes.blurb: Peaches baked up through a golden, buttery batter

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Put the butter in a 9x13-inch dish and melt it in the oven, about 5 minutes.
Whisk the flour, 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. Stir in the milk to make a smooth batter.
Pour the batter over the melted butter. Do not stir.
Toss the peaches with 1/4 cup sugar, lemon juice and cinnamon.
Spoon the peaches and their juices evenly over the batter.
Bake until the batter rises around the fruit and is deep golden.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Blueberry crisp
recipes.blurb: Jammy blueberries under crunchy oat crumble

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9-inch square baking dish.
Toss the blueberries with the sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice. Spread in the dish.
Mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt.
Rub in the cold butter until crumbly.
Scatter the topping over the berries.
Bake until the topping is golden and the berries bubble.
Cool 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cherry pie
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tart cherries in a lattice-top crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F with a baking sheet on the lower rack. Fit one crust into a 9-inch pie plate.
Mix the cherries with their juices, sugar, cornstarch, almond extract and lemon juice.
Pour the filling into the crust and dot with butter.
Cut the second crust into strips and weave a lattice over the top. Crimp the edges and brush with egg.
Bake on the baking sheet at 425°F.
Lower to 375°F and bake until golden and bubbling. Cover edges if browning too fast.
Cool at least 3 hours before slicing.

recipes.title: Blackberry cobbler
recipes.blurb: Bubbling berries under tender drop biscuits

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Have an 8-inch square baking dish ready.
Toss the berries with 1/2 cup sugar, cornstarch and lemon juice. Spread in the dish.
Whisk the flour, 1/4 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. Cut in the cold butter until crumbly.
Stir in the milk just until a soft dough forms.
Drop spoonfuls of dough over the berries, leaving gaps.
Bake until the biscuits are golden and the berries bubble.
Cool 10 minutes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Banana cream pie
recipes.blurb: Vanilla custard and bananas in a graham crust

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the crumbs, 6 tbsp melted butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Press into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake the crust, then cool.
Whisk the custard sugar, cornstarch and salt in a saucepan. Whisk in the milk and yolks.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thick and bubbling.
Off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp butter and the vanilla.
Layer half the bananas in the crust, pour in the hot custard, press plastic wrap on top and chill 4 hours.
Whip the cream with the powdered sugar. Top the pie with the cream and the remaining bananas.

recipes.title: Lemon meringue pie
recipes.blurb: Tart lemon curd under a toasted meringue

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Fit the crust in a 9-inch plate, prick it, line with parchment and weights.
Bake the crust, then remove the weights and bake 5 minutes more.
Whisk 1.5 cups sugar and the cornstarch in a saucepan. Whisk in the water and 4 yolks.
Cook, whisking, until thick and bubbling.
Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice, zest and butter. Pour into the warm crust.
Lower the oven to 350°F. Whip the 4 whites with cream of tartar, adding 1/2 cup sugar slowly, to stiff peaks.
Spread the meringue to the crust edges, sealing it, and swirl the top.
Bake until the meringue is golden. Cool 2 hours, then chill.

recipes.title: Chocolate cream pie
recipes.blurb: Rich chocolate pudding in a graham crust, topped with cream

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Mix the crumbs, 6 tbsp melted butter and 1/4 cup sugar. Press into a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake the crust, then cool.
Whisk 2/3 cup sugar, cornstarch, cocoa and salt in a saucepan. Whisk in the milk and yolks.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thick and bubbling.
Off the heat, stir in the chocolate chips, 2 tbsp butter and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into the crust, press plastic wrap on top and chill at least 4 hours.
Whip the cream with the powdered sugar and spoon it over the pie.

recipes.title: No-bake cheesecake
recipes.blurb: Creamy, light and set in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the graham crumbs, melted butter and sugar. Press firmly into a 9-inch springform pan or pie plate.
Chill the crust while you make the filling.
Beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla and lemon juice until completely smooth.
In another bowl, whip the cold cream to stiff peaks.
Fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese in two additions.
Spread the filling over the crust and smooth the top.
Cover and chill until firm.
Run a knife around the edge before releasing the pan. Slice and serve cold.

recipes.title: Rice crispy treats
recipes.blurb: Gooey marshmallow cereal bars

steps.text: Butter a 9x13-inch pan.
Melt the butter in a large pot over low heat.
Add the marshmallows and stir until completely melted and smooth.
Remove from the heat and quickly stir in the cereal until coated.
Press into the pan with buttered hands or wax paper. Do not pack too hard.
Let set until firm, then cut into 16 squares.

recipes.title: No-bake chocolate oatmeal cookies
recipes.blurb: Fudgy stovetop cookies with peanut butter

steps.text: Line two baking sheets with wax paper. Measure everything before you start.
Bring the sugar, butter, milk and cocoa to a full boil in a saucepan, stirring.
Boil for exactly 1 minute, stirring constantly. This sets the cookies.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in the oats quickly.
Drop heaping tablespoons onto the wax paper.
Let stand until set.

recipes.title: Banana pudding
recipes.blurb: Layers of vanilla pudding, wafers and bananas

steps.text: Whisk the pudding mix, cold milk and condensed milk for 2 minutes. Chill 5 minutes to thicken.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold it into the pudding.
Layer vanilla wafers in the bottom of a 9x13-inch dish or trifle bowl.
Add a layer of banana slices, then a layer of pudding. Repeat the layers.
Finish with pudding and crush a few wafers on top.
Cover and chill so the wafers soften.

recipes.title: Easy chocolate mousse
recipes.blurb: Silky mousse from just chocolate and cream

steps.text: Put the chocolate in a large bowl.
Heat 1/2 cup cream until steaming, pour over the chocolate and let sit 2 minutes.
Stir until smooth, then stir in the vanilla and salt. Cool to room temperature.
Whip the remaining 1.5 cups cream with the sugar to soft peaks.
Fold a third of the cream into the chocolate, then fold in the rest gently.
Spoon into 6 glasses.
Chill until set.

recipes.title: Easy chocolate fudge
recipes.blurb: Three-ingredient fudge, no candy thermometer

steps.text: Line an 8-inch square pan with parchment, leaving an overhang.
Combine the chips and condensed milk in a saucepan over low heat.
Stir constantly until the chips are melted and the mixture is smooth.
Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Spread into the pan and smooth the top.
Chill until firm.
Lift out and cut into 36 squares with a warm knife.

recipes.title: Strawberry icebox cake
recipes.blurb: Graham crackers soften into cake under whipped cream

steps.text: Whip the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla to stiff peaks.
Spread a thin layer of cream in a 9x13-inch dish.
Cover with a layer of graham crackers, breaking them to fit.
Top with a third of the cream and a third of the strawberries.
Repeat the layers twice more, ending with cream and berries.
Cover and chill so the crackers turn soft and cakey.
Cut into squares and serve cold.

recipes.title: Peanut butter pie
recipes.blurb: Fluffy peanut butter filling with a chocolate drizzle

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, peanut butter, powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Whip the cold cream to stiff peaks.
Fold a third of the cream into the peanut butter mixture, then fold in the rest.
Spoon the filling into the crust and smooth the top.
Melt the chocolate chips with the oil in the microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring each time.
Drizzle the chocolate over the pie.
Chill until firm before slicing.

recipes.title: Frozen yogurt bark
recipes.blurb: Berry-studded Greek yogurt, frozen in a sheet

steps.text: Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Stir the yogurt, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Spread the yogurt about 1/4 inch thick on the parchment.
Scatter the blueberries, strawberries and chocolate chips over the top and press in lightly.
Freeze until completely solid.
Break into 12 pieces and store in the freezer.

recipes.title: Cut-out sugar cookies with icing
recipes.blurb: Holds its shape for cookie cutters

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt together.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture to make a dough. Divide in two and flatten into discs.
Wrap the discs and chill until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick on a floured surface and cut shapes.
Bake on parchment-lined sheets until the edges are just golden.
Cool completely. Whisk the powdered sugar, milk and corn syrup into an icing, then decorate.

recipes.title: Gingerbread cookies
recipes.blurb: Spicy, molasses-rich cookies for cutting

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and salt together.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the molasses and egg.
Mix in the flour mixture. Divide the dough in two and flatten into discs.
Wrap and chill until firm.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick and cut shapes.
Bake on parchment-lined sheets until the edges look set.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Pumpkin pie
recipes.blurb: The Thanksgiving classic with a smooth spiced filling

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Fit the crust into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate and crimp the edge.
Whisk the sugar, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in the eggs, then the pumpkin, then the evaporated milk.
Pour the filling into the crust.
Bake at 425°F.
Lower to 350°F and bake until a knife in the center comes out clean.
Cool at least 2 hours. Chill if keeping overnight.

recipes.title: Pecan pie
recipes.blurb: Gooey caramel-like filling under toasty pecans

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Fit the crust into a 9-inch pie plate and crimp the edge.
Whisk the eggs, corn syrup, sugar, melted butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Spread the pecans in the crust and pour the filling over them.
Bake until the center is puffed and only slightly jiggly. Cover the edge if it browns fast.
Cool at least 2 hours so the filling sets.

recipes.title: Peppermint bark
recipes.blurb: Dark and white chocolate layers with candy cane crunch

steps.text: Line a 9x13-inch pan or baking sheet with parchment.
Melt the semisweet chips in the microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring each time, until smooth. Stir in 1/2 tsp extract.
Spread the dark chocolate evenly into a rectangle.
Chill until firm.
Melt the white chocolate the same way and stir in the remaining 1/2 tsp extract.
Spread over the dark layer and sprinkle with crushed candy canes, pressing lightly.
Chill until firm, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Peanut butter buckeyes
recipes.blurb: Peanut butter fudge balls dipped in chocolate

steps.text: Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Beat the peanut butter, butter and vanilla until smooth, then mix in the powdered sugar.
Roll into 1-inch balls and set on the sheet.
Chill the balls until firm.
Melt the chocolate chips and oil in the microwave in 30-second bursts, stirring.
Hold a ball on a toothpick, dip into the chocolate leaving a circle of peanut butter showing.
Set on parchment and chill until the chocolate is firm.

recipes.title: Jam thumbprint cookies
recipes.blurb: Buttery shortbread cookies with a jewel of jam

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the yolks and vanilla.
Mix in the flour and salt to make a soft dough.
Roll into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart. Press a deep thumbprint into each.
Spoon about 1/2 teaspoon jam into each well.
Bake until the edges are lightly golden.
Cool on a rack and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate crinkle cookies
recipes.blurb: Fudgy cocoa cookies cracked with powdered sugar

steps.text: Whisk the cocoa, sugar and oil until smooth. Whisk in the vanilla and eggs one at a time.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt to make a soft dough.
Cover and chill until firm enough to roll.
Heat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Roll the dough into 1-inch balls and coat very thickly in powdered sugar.
Place 2 inches apart and bake until the cracks are set. Do not overbake.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack.

recipes.title: Cranberry orange loaf
recipes.blurb: Tart cranberries and bright orange in a tender loaf

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and line a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt together.
Whisk the orange zest, juice, melted butter and egg in another bowl.
Stir the wet ingredients into the dry just until combined, then fold in the cranberries.
Scrape the batter into the pan.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes, lift out and cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: Pumpkin bread
recipes.blurb: Two moist, spiced loaves for gifting or freezing

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour two 9x5-inch loaf pans.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg together.
Whisk the sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin and water until smooth.
Stir the flour mixture into the wet ingredients just until combined.
Divide the batter between the pans.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes, turn out and cool completely before slicing.
